library_preparation_preflight.summary: h2gis-utilities is a DB-agnostic metadata layer (JDBCUtilities, GeometryTableUtilities, TableLocation) that reads geometry_columns/spatial_ref_sys catalog views; those only exist once H2GIS's spatial extension is loaded via H2GISFunctions, which lives in the sibling org.orbisgis:h2gis artifact, not in h2gis-utilities itself.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Before exercising org.h2gis.utilities classes, open an H2 in-memory connection and call org.h2gis.functions.factory.H2GISFunctions.load(connection) (same pattern as H2gisTest in tests/src/org.orbisgis/h2gis/2.2.5) so there is an actual spatial schema (GEOMETRY-typed columns, geometry_columns, spatial_ref_sys) for JDBCUtilities/GeometryTableUtilities/TableLocation to read. Without this, the generated tests would only have a bare relational H2 database with nothing spatial to introspect, and most of the library's logic would go unreached.
risks: No network access was available in this session to directly confirm h2gis-utilities' POM dependencies on Maven Central; the recommendation is based on strong structural evidence from the already-shipped sibling h2gis test rather than a direct POM read — verify dependency resolution during generateMetadata.

PostgreSQL/PostGIS-specific branches (DBTypes.POSTGRESQL/POSTGIS detection) won't be exercised via the H2-only path above. No PostGIS Docker image is currently pinned in allowed-docker-images (only plain postgres:18-alpine), so adding one would be a new allow-list entry; left out here since H2GIS's catalog-view emulation should already cover most of the utility logic and no concrete evidence of a hard requirement was found.
